chunks: about dyed garments that a woman in ihram wears, so he said: “There is no harm, except for the prominently dyed garment.”

key_terms.الْمُحْرِمَةُ: a woman in the state of ihram
key_terms.الْمُفْدَمُ: a strongly or intensely dyed garment
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible
key_terms.مُصَبَّغَاتِ: dyed items, referring here to garments colored with dye

ai.seo_question: Can a woman in ihram wear dyed clothing?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning what a woman in ihram may wear. It indicates that dyed garments are generally permissible for her, except those that are conspicuously and prominently dyed.
